name: Universidad de Cadiz
overview:
IMPORTANT - ADDITIONAL PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS

Students must submit the following with their choices in order to be eligible for this destination


DELE Spanish test (level B2 mandatory)


___________________________________________________________________________________


The University of Cadiz (UCA) is the public university of the Spanish province of Cadiz. It includes more than 1,500 teachers and welcomes around 20,000 students from many countries.


The University of Cadiz was founded in 1979, although several of its faculties already existed previously as schools or faculties independent of the University of Seville.


From its inception, this Andalusian university has strived to modernize its infrastructure and reach a level of excellence. In 15 years, it has built no less than 4 new faculties.


Its facilities are spread over several campuses:

  • Cadiz
  • Algeciras Bay
  • Jerez
  • Rio San Pedro (Puerto Real)


The first hosts most of the university's faculties and schools, including the Higher School of Engineering.


Internationalization is one of the priorities of the university, which has many programs for its students.


For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Spain, click here.
administrative:
1) Application dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).


If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.


Additionally, you must prove you have a B2 level in Spanish via a DELE test.


To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa


For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).


For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.


Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance


For European students


The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe. To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For non-European students


You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/ public / login.html
accomodation:
The university's housing department can put you in touch with apartment and room owners to help you find accommodations. They will give you several options, so that you can choose the proposal that is most suitable for you and you can speak directly with the owners. You can also get in touch with other students looking for roommates.


The University of Cadiz does not have its own university residence. Indeed, they are all private. Again, the service can provide you with a list of contacts so you can choose the one that works best for you.


Students from previous years were able to find accommodations through the following site: http://www.idealista.com/


You can also consult this link: https://atencionalumnado.uca.es/alojamiento-oficina-de-alojamiento/


Knowing that your lessons will be given near the Puerto Real campus, you can find accommodation nearby or in the old town of Cadiz, located 1 hour from Puerto Real. Student life is however more developed in Cadiz itself.


You can also search for an apartment in Cadiz on Facebook "Erasmus Cadiz" groups.


However, note that the bus network is very poorly designed to get to the University in Puerto Real.
courses:
You must obtain 30 ECTS a semester, i.e. 60 ECTS credits for the year among the courses from the third year (curso 3) of the Escuela Superior de Ingenieria: https://oficinadeposgrado.uca.es/


Courses are in Spanish. The semester dates are as follows: from late September to early July of the following year.


Please note:


Computer courses are given on the "ESI" campus located near the Puerto Real campus.


The school administration is on the Puerto Real campus itself.


Attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.


The course list is given to you for information purposes. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.


EIP: Any Tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
cost:
Estimated Budget:


  • Plane: Paris–Seville around 120 € (round trip with Vueling) + 13.30 € Seville–Cadiz by train
  •     or
  •     Paris–Jerez de la Frontera around 250 € (round trip with Iberia) + 14.50 € Jerez–Cadiz by train
  • Insurance: European "Améli" insurance card (free)
  • Rent: From € 230 / month in shared accommodations or from € 300 / month for single accommodations
  • Charges:
  • Electricity: 30 €
  • Water: 30 €
  • Gas: 10 €
  • Meal: 150 €
  • Food: 80 € / month for one person
  • Bus trips: 50 € / month
  • It is necessary to take the ESI bus which goes directly to the IT campus.
  • Telephone: 50 €
  • Certificate of Spanish language to be passed with an approved body like the Cervantes Institute: 113 €


These prices are indicative, and may vary.
